items.zh: 我们记得凋零的美，消褪的爱。
items.en: We remember a beauty that faded, a love that waned.

items.zh: 一些富裕国家甚至在考虑全面禁烟。
items.en: Some rich countries are even flirting with all-out bans.

items.zh: 但其实，有关争议一直在演化。
items.en: But in fact, controversy has really waxed and waned over time.

items.zh: 在公共服务方面，北欧国家同样务实。
items.en: On public services, the Nordics have been similarly pragmatic.

items.zh: 人们被限制在家中，于是开始凝视宇宙。
items.en: Confined to their homes, people took to gazing at the cosmos.

items.zh: 它提供了一种在现代世界难以觅得的宁静。
items.en: They offer a stillness that is hard to find in much of the modern world,
